description: Success comes from setting targets and an action plan to get you there.  Here are the most important KPI we set every quarter.  #metaadstips #metaadsspecialist #facebookadstips #metaads #facebookadvertisingtips
transcript: Ever wondered what's inside an agency's KPI tracker? It's July and we have just done our quarterly goals for all our clients and I thought I would share what exactly we set at the beginning of every quarter so you can have a look. Now these are just place holder numbers. I've removed all the data of our actual clients, but you can have a little bit of a breakdown of what we actually track. So it's really important that whenever a client starts with us, we understand their contribution margin essentially that is written at the top of the quarterly tracker. And we have our target merge as well. So we kind of each week have a green, orange and red light system to ensure that we are not going below, I guess red or orange as we continue to increase our spend. Now for the quarter we set our target net revenue, our target new customer revenue and our percentage of new customers that we are trying to hit which will give us how many new customers we're actually trying to gather for the quarter. We then have our spend breakdown and then our net mer goal and our nack goal as you can see here. And then that will leave us with a snapshot of the profitability that we hope to achieve for the client at the end of the quarter. Now we always map out our creative plan for the quarter as much as we can. And we will have how many creators we aim to launch per month and what is the percentage of winners we hope to achieve to give us a hit rate. So this is a breakdown of a quarterly K P I tracker within my agency.
